architectureDecisions: D1 — Export AGENT_CHILD_INHERITED_ENV = Object.freeze(['PATH','HOME','USER','LOGNAME','SHELL','TMPDIR','TEMP','TMP','LANG','LC_ALL','LC_CTYPE','TERM','TERM_PROGRAM','COLORTERM','XDG_CONFIG_HOME','XDG_CACHE_HOME','XDG_DATA_HOME','XDG_RUNTIME_DIR','XDG_STATE_HOME','USERPROFILE','HOMEDRIVE','HOMEPATH','APPDATA','LOCALAPPDATA','PATHEXT','SYSTEMROOT','COMSPEC','WINDIR']) from process-runner.js and index.js. childEnvironment copies only those names from process.env (own string properties).

D2 — childEnvironment(env, { tool } = {}) returns { ...inheritedAllowlist, ...authPassthrough(tool), ...overlay } (overlay = env || {}). authPassthrough copies the tool's frozen authEnvNames own-string values from process.env. Always skip/delete NODE_TEST_CONTEXT (including overlay). Never spread process.env. spawnBounded takes optional tool; runAgentInvocation passes it; runProcess and version probes pass none (no auth passthrough).

D3 — Every adapter has frozen authEnvNames. defineAgentTool validates it (frozen string array; default frozen []) and preserves it. Delivered codex, kiro, agy, grok adapters declare []. No vendor auth names without verified vendor docs; operators pass auth via overlay or bin --env.

D4 — Export binOverlayEnv(binProcessEnv, envFlags) from process-runner.js: pick FAKE_AGENT_* strings from binProcessEnv, then apply parsed --env last. bin run/smoke collect repeated --env KEY=VALUE (malformed -> UsageError, exit 64) and pass binOverlayEnv(process.env, flags) as env to runSupervisedTask. probe, deliver, report unchanged.
D5 — PATH and HOME stay on the allowlist so CLIs resolve binaries and homedir config. ExHarness does not read ~/.codex or credentials.

D6 — EN1–EN7 use runProcess(process.execPath, ['-e', dump]) and runAgentInvocation with defineAgentTool. Plant EXHARNESS_PLANTED_SECRET and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY on process.env; assert absent unless overlay or authEnvNames. Assert overlay FAKE_AGENT_SCENARIO and PATH/HOME when parent has them. EN6 also calls binOverlayEnv(...) and spawns the bin with FAKE_AGENT_SCENARIO and --env as AT4/GR3 so the fake CLI sees them. Restore planted keys in finally.

D7 — docs/living/system/agent-tools/state.md Trust boundary: child env is allowlist plus declared per-tool auth passthrough plus caller overlay forwarded through the bin; host process.env secrets are not inherited; operator overlay wins. No Blackboard ids.

D8 — Evidence: env-allowlist-probe-result.json (spreads process.env; planted secrets and PATH/HOME inherited; NODE_TEST_CONTEXT stripped; childEnvironment unexported) and plan-defect-probe-result.json (D2 + supervisor default drops FAKE_AGENT_SCENARIO/RECORD and auth names; bin passes no env; corrected rule forwards declared auth and bin overlay, drops undeclared ambient secrets).
D9 — observation.js mergedEnv remains a full process.env scan for redaction only, not spawn env. Do not edit observation.js.
D10 — auditPaths against this plan rejects packages/core-harness/** and docs/blackboard/**.

S2 — Secrets and overlay [EN2,EN3]: planted parent secrets absent unless overlay/declared; overlay keys present; NODE_TEST_CONTEXT absent.
S3 — Auth passthrough [EN5]: adapter authEnvNames declared names forwarded, undeclared ambient dropped, overlay wins.
S4 — Bin forwarding [EN6]: FAKE_AGENT_* plus --env reach the supervised child; delivered AT4/GR3 pass unmodified. PATH/HOME [EN4] covered with S1.
S5 — Docs and scope [EN7]: Living trust-boundary paragraph; auditPaths rejects core-harness.
